Phainon has always been a doting partner. His whole paycheck will go towards spoiling whoever he's seeing, he'll buy them their favourite foods so long as there's no cooking involved, and he loves taking care of his lovers (and his friends, for that matter) in any way he can.

Despite that, he's never pictured himself with a catboy.

Don't get him wrong, he's got nothing against beastmen! They're great people. But he's never been a cat person, and the thought of keeping a species with human intelligence and communication as a pet freaks him out.

Which is why he finds himself a little confused with his current situation.

Mydeimos. His close friend Mydeimos, the most gorgeous man with the fluffiest golden cat ears and tail. The ends of his fur stick up in the cutest tufts, fading from a honeyed gold to a blushing red at the tips.

After Mydei was kicked out of his father's house and had his allowance cut, Phainon graciously offered him a spot on his couch. That arrangement had suited them for a while – So well that Mydei ended up moving in full time, and when his lease ran out they decided to rent their own two-bedroom flat together.

He’s… lazier than Phainon would’ve thought. Much of his day is spent lounging in a spot of sun by the window with a book or napping in a pile of Phainon’s clothes.

That isn’t to say he does nothing all day. He bakes, cooks Phainon meals (if Phainon buys the ingredients), and he even works out every other day! He was doing online classes until he realised, hey, instead of working my ass off for a degree I don’t want to please my dad, I can sit around Phainon’s house and do cat things all day.

But when he’s not doing any of those, he’s stretching out like a lazy housecat for a warm nap in the sun.

Phainon has no problem with the catboy crawling into his bed at night. The warmth of his soft, furry tail wrapping around him unconsciously, pulling him close throughout the night is a feeling he quickly grew fond of. He does sort of regret going for the two-bedroom, though… Mydei never sleeps in his own bed. His room is more of his ‘alone time’ space.

He doesn't really go out unless Phainon asks him to, he makes Phainon work out with him, and he makes Phainon chat with him for idle noise while he bakes.

Functionally, he’s Phainon’s pet cat, even if they call themselves ‘roommates’. A spoiled kitty cat that makes Phainon scratch behind his ears when they watch movies. Uses his couch as a scratching post.

Currently, a pouty Phainon lays on their scratched up couch waiting for Mydei to get home from the gym. Bored, he fiddles with a spot on a pillow where stuffing overflows from a scratch mark.

The absence of Mydei’s contented purrs is loud in the space of their cluttered apartment. It’s a sound Phainon has grown rather attached to, the noisy, happy trills from his roommate. He gets so embarrassed, too, like he struggles to contain his inner cat. Unable to control his purrs and the swish of his pretty, neatly groomed tail, his face always gets so red and he’ll deny it. But Phainon adores it. Who would he be without a rumbling catboy next to him on the couch practically begging for pets?

A jolt wracks his frame when keys jingle noisily in the lock. The rustling of shoes being kicked off. The quiet padding of a tired catboy’s steps. Springing to his feet, Phainon nearly slips on his own socks when he comes into contact with the wooden floor, stumbling in his effort to meet his roommate at the door.

“Gym,” He blurts, fumbling into the kitchen and leaning his elbow on the cluttered countertop, “how was it?”

He chuckles at the grumbling, exerted hum he receives in return. Mydei stretches his arms above his head – Phainon tries not to be a freak and eye his pits. “Mrrp,” comes a strained noise along with a quiet pop when he arches his back. “I need a shower–It was fine. You weren’t there. Why.”

The fridge fills the quiet apartment with a low hum when Mydei opens it to grab a cold bottle of water. His tail swishes in a pleased motion behind him, almost hypnotic as he throws his head back to take a parched gulp of water.

Phainon doesn’t watch the way his throat bobs, the way a stray droplet streaks down his chin, his throat, between his tits in that stupid tank top– he’s normal.

“Did you miss me?”

“I did not miss you,” rumbles Mydei, wiping his mouth, “but you always come with me. So what were you doing that was more important than me?”

A pleased hum slips from Phainon’s throat at the notion of Mydei, his sweet, spoiled kitty Mydei, missing him after only a few short hours apart. A dopey grin spreading across his face, he rests his chin in the palm of his hand. It feels almost as if he has his own wagging tail to match Mydei’s. “I had to go buy some stuff,” he excuses lamely, waving his free hand dismissively.

That earns him a squint of amber eyes, a narrowing of pupils to slits. After all, Mydei knows him best of all; he can tell something’s up. He tosses his empty water bottle, sending it clattering into the trash with the precision of an athlete. A muscle in his jaw ticks, but his face remains mostly still as he prowls closer like a hunting wildcat.

The salty, heavy scent of sweat grows stronger the nearer he draws, and Phainon’s heart beats a little faster. His steps would be entirely silent if not for the quiet creaking of the old wooden floor under him. “You're ridiculous,” accuses Mydei, tail lashing behind him in a golden blur. “You think you can lie to me?”

Phainon's clammy grip finds the counter behind him, his knuckles whitening from the force. “Lie?”

He's red in the face. He chuckles airily, eyes darting around the room, finding anything but Mydei's face. The rays of light filtering through the sheer curtains, the colourful magnets and notes on the fridge, the dwindling stack of cookies in the jar.

But it becomes impossible to avoid him when Mydei is close enough. Right in his face. So close that he can make out each long, blond eyelash that seems to flutter when he blinks. A stray lash sits on his cheek, just below his eye. “There's–”

“Are you buying weird shit again?”

His chest stings and the fabric of his shirt bunches when a clawed finger jabs accusingly into his chest. “Ow. Do not– do not accuse me of a crime I did not commit!” He fumbles to grab Mydei’s wrist, forcing him to ease the sharp poking lest he tear his shirt. He likes this one, it’s a nice pale lilac with a little puppy on it, and it’s one of the few Mydei didn’t make him throw out when he moved in!

The stiffness of his words only adds to the suspicion. Mydei gently–okay, not that gently–bumps his forehead into the side of Phainon’s burning cheek. Like a cat. He does that thing, that dumb irresistible thing he does where he makes a little “mrrrp” right by Phainon’s ear, nuzzles their cheeks together like a needy housecat. And he only does it because he knows it will make Phainon fold instantly.

“What did you buy, Deliverer?”

He nearly draws blood from how hard he bites his lip. A defeated sigh escapes him, and when he replies he makes sure to brush the stray lash from Mydei's cheek.

“Okay, I kind of had an evil plan.”

Mydei rumbles against him with a pleased purr at his confession, pulling back to look at him. “Your plan being?”

Phainon’s teeth dig into his lower lip. “So you remember the bet we made about Cas and Cipher…?”

His hands go to fiddle nervously with Mydei’s fuzzy tail, making the purrs grow louder. Mydei nods.

“And you remember the stakes?”

A muscle ticks in Mydei’s jaw and he raises an eyebrow, stepping back and crossing muscled arms over his chest. “The winner has to do whatever–within reason–the loser wants. For a week. Tell me where you’re going with this.”

Phainon whines. Mydei makes him nervous, okay? What if he tells him and he scratches his eyes out and pisses in his shoes? He’s a cat!

Shuffling his feet, he begins, “well, last night I got some news from Cas…”

“No.”

“...and before I shared that news with you, I thought I would buy some supplies for your week under my command…”

“Deliverer.”

“...and I was going to return some of them because I realised they were kind of crazy, but–”

He’s cut off by an exasperated groan. Mydei retracts his claws, running a hand down his face in a sort of facepalm. “Stop talking. I’m going to shower, you’re going to blend the ingredients in the top of the fridge, and then you’re going to tell me while you hold my drink for me and scratch my ears.”

Like a puppy, Phainon ducks his head, looking up at his roommate through white lashes. “Yes, Mydei.”

His agreement earns him a satisfied ‘hmph’ and Mydei pads to the bathroom, lifting the shoulder of his top and grimacing at the smell.

Like the good roommate he is, Phainon heads to Mydei’s room to grab him some clean clothes. He hurries to the drawer, though, trying hard not to bask in the scent of pomegranates and honey that hangsin the air of the space. It’s neat, comfy, and nicely designed unlike Phainon’s. Vibrant reds and pale golds, blankets and pillows and even a sort of cat tree–human sized, of course–it’s a big box with a hole for Mydei to climb into, attached to a few small padded platforms for him to sit on or climb between. Phainon has to stifle a giggle every time he sees that thing. So, so cute.

The bed is untouched, as per usual when Mydei is slinking into Phainon's ratty queen-sized mattress every night.

He grabs a shirt from the closet, a soft, cotton pink one with a pixelated print of the Pokemon Espeon plastered on the front. (Phainon thinks Umbreon is cooler, but whatever.)

A loose pair of shorts from a drawer, black with a paw print design on the back pocket.

Lastly, the underwear. It takes a moment for him to work up the courage to pull the drawer open, and by the time he does his face is burning hot. He doesn’t want to be pervy going through his roommates underwear drawer, but he looks in. Not closely. Nope, he’s not examining what type of colours and materials Mydei likes to wear under his clothes. He sorts through them, biting down on the inside of his cheek.

Lace. Cute, frilly, lacy panty-shorts. Pink. With a bow. Low-riding for his tail, like all his bottoms.

Mydei wears pink lace panties.

He rubs the material between his thumbs. It’s not that rough, scratchy material you’d normally expect from lace. It’s nice. Comfy.

Blinking the perverted thoughts away, he sets the panties on top of the other clothes and carries them back to the bathroom door.

Enough of that–Mydei will be pissy if he doesn’t blend his sweet treat of a drink.

Right… juicer, check. Blender, check. He opens the fridge, that soothing hum filling his ears again as he goes straight for the top shelf, laying the ingredients out on the countertop.

The ingredients combine to make a nice, sweet aroma he’s sure Mydei will love. In his head, he imagines Mydei giving him instructions on how to make his drink just like he likes it.

Put the ‘arils’ (so fancy, just call them seeds) in the juicer.

Mydei knows him well, because instead of Phainon clumsily cutting a square into a pomegranate and peeling it apart, the seeds are packed into a little tupperware.

Okay, seeds, juicer. Check. Extract the juice. Yes, Mydei. One cup worth of juice is just right, right? Right.

Right. Pour the juice into the jar, and don’t spill a drop or I’ll scratch up the curtains.

One cup of goat's milk, creamy just like Mydei likes. Pour it slowly, be careful!

A tablespoon of that stupidly expensive honey you drive two hours to the farmer’s market for and pay for with my money. (It’s high quality, Mydei! Straight from the bee’s teat, nothing compares to honey from his hometown.)

He’s totally smiling like an idiot, dopey and smitten at his own imaginary Mydei, or rather the memory of when he’d first taught him his favourite recipe.

Tablespoon of greek yoghurt, it’s good for you.

And finally, a scoop of vanilla protein powder. He allows himself a fist pump at the lack of spillage, turning the blender on and cleaning up while it works.

All freshened up, Mydei emerges from the bathroom in a cloud of steam.

“Jeez.” Phainon sets the pink smoothie down on the coffee table, flopping down on the scratched up couch. “I still don’t get how you don’t burn your skin off when you shower that hot.”

“It’s cleansing,” says Mydei, and curls up next to him on the couch. “Straw.”

Rolling his eyes, Phainon sticks the curly red straw into the smoothie, holding the glass up to where Mydei can reach.

He wraps his pretty, soft lips around the straw, swallowing down the thick drink. He moans quietly, licks his lips and waves his hand for Phainon to put it down.

“Now,” he starts.

“Oh. You want to talk, huh…”

Mydei gives him a look. “Pet me. And tell me what you bought, and what torture I’m about to endure for the next week.” He starts his purring back up when Phainon scratches behind his soft, fluffy ears, leaning into his touch.

“So, Cas called me last night.”

Mydei hums in acknowledgement, eyes shut contentedly and tail curling around Phainon’s wrist.

He bites back a smile. “And she informed me,” a pause for suspense, “that she’s going on a, quote unquote, date date. With Cipher.”

The happy purring pauses, and a golden cat eye cracks open to lock gazes with Phainon.

“A date date,” he repeats incredulously.

But here they were. A date date.

Mydei takes his drink, brows twitching to furrow in a pouty frown at the cocky smirk. “Yes, yes, you win, HKS. Show me what you bought.”

His face scrunches up–he looks like he’s sucking on a lemon. “Mrrrrr…”

“Oh no no, my dear Mydeimos. This,” he gestures, “is catnip.”

Cute. Silly. Dumb, even. All euphoric and blissed out, getting catnip all over their floor while he rolled around and rubbed his face in it.

Slowly, golden cat eyes meet him once more. He smiles a sunny grin down at his companion. “Hmmm…” Tapping his chin, he takes a moment to consider. “What do you think good kitties do to earn treats from their Master, Mydei?”

Shooting him an indignant glare, Mydei growls.

“Ah-ah,” scolds Phainon, still smiling, “do you want it or not?”

A soft, barely audible whine. More incoherent, muffled words.

Turning his face to the side so his mouth is uncovered, Mydei huffs stubbornly. “You can… do whatever you want to me.”

“W-what do you mean,” he blurts. He's worried he's reading this wrong, because… what? Anything?

Mydei moves suddenly, climbing clumsily back into his lap and burying his face against him. The bell on his collar jingles loudly. “You can do anything,” he breathes against his neck. “With me. Mydei nods.

“And you'll say what if you want me to stop?” Prompts Phainon, languidly rubbing the catboy’s lower back. He can almost feel his body rumbling with quiet purrs.

Cute…
